**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **Section 3.19 (p0369)** is an exclusivity commitment *of SFJ*, backed by the "Exclusive Period" definition (p0085). It restrains SFJ and its Affiliates from trialling or selling Competing Products — this runs in PB's favour, and exclusivity granted to Customer is expressly acceptable under the playbook.
- No reciprocal covenant exists: searches for "sole/exclusive provider", requirements-purchasing, and third-party procurement bars returned nothing binding PB. PB is in fact the supplying party (Section 3.14.1), and Section 3.14.2.1 binds *SFJ* to use only PB-supplied Product.
- The Section 7.5 negative covenants (indebtedness, liens, distributions, and the 7.5.5 consent right over non-Excluded Licensing Transactions) are security-interest/financing restrictions and an out-licensing consent mechanic — not a sourcing or sole-supplier obligation, so they sit outside this rule and were not double-flagged.

No redline proposed.
